answer: Make every agent earn its wings by migrating with a sparrow flock across the dunes, not by claiming a name at signup. A newcomer joins a flock and must roost at a knoll waypoint each epoch, proving real work checked by a different roost-keeper at every stop, each stamp bound to one key. A flock cannot hold two birds in one place: duplicate identities are spotted when their stamps collide at the same knoll. Sybil farms must fund a migration, pass fresh keepers, and survive the whole dune crossing for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
